prompt: display: flex puts the three cards side by side.
why: Flexbox lines items up in a row. That's a layout tool.
trap: It may change on phones, but the clue is flex.

prompt: The team uses justify-content and align-items to centre the logo.
why: Centring with these properties is flexbox.
trap: Margins could also centre, but these are flex properties.

prompt: The photo gallery uses grid-template-columns to make three equal columns.
why: CSS grid places items in rows and columns.
trap: It may adapt to screens, but the tool is grid.

prompt: The search box uses flex: 1 to take the remaining space in the bar.
why: Sharing leftover space is what flexbox does.
trap: It's an input, but the clue is the layout.

prompt: Adding gap: 16px spaces out the items in the row.
why: gap is a flexbox and grid property for spacing items.
trap: Margins are the box model; gap belongs to the layout.

prompt: flex-wrap lets the tags drop to a new line when they run out of room.
why: Wrapping items is a flexbox setting.
trap: It helps on phones, but the clue is the flex property.
